info.name: Holvi PSD2 Account Information Payment Initiation API

items.docs: Initiates a payment from a Holvi customer payment account. Supports SEPA, SEPA Instant and SWIFT (international) payments. After initiation the customer must complete Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) on their phone; poll the payment state until it becomes `verified`. Set `execute_verification_of_payee: true` to run Verification of Payee (VOP) - a perfect match returns 201, a fuzzy/no match returns 202 requiring confirmation.

info.name: Confirm a payment after VOP fuzzy/no match

params.name: payment_initialization_id
params.description: The ID returned from the initial VOP payment request.

items.docs: When VOP returns a fuzzy match or no match (202), call this endpoint to confirm and proceed with the payment after the user has reviewed the name mismatch.
